name: photoshop-mcp-imt
description: Drive a running Adobe Photoshop from Claude: documents, layers, text, masks, filters, generative tools, export.
long_description: PS-MCP-IMT by Immersive Media Technologies. 134 Photoshop operations behind a 9-tool facade, a UXP bridge that keeps answering while Photoshop shows a dialog, headless corner-pin, honest errors, no telemetry. Requires Adobe Photoshop 2024+ running on this computer. Non-commercial license; unofficial, not affiliated with Adobe Inc.

facade.title: Compact tool surface (9 tools)
facade.description: On: the model sees ps_catalog / ps_do and 7 helpers (~900 tokens) and reaches every operation through ps_do. Off: all 134 photoshop_* tools are listed directly.

uxpBridge.title: UXP bridge (second transport)
uxpBridge.description: Start the local bridge for the Deep Artisan Bridge panel plugin (127.0.0.1:38452, shared-secret token). Needs the plugin installed in Photoshop — see the README.

uxpPrefer.title: Prefer UXP for reads, save and export
uxpPrefer.description: Try the UXP plugin first for state / layers / save / export, ExtendScript second. Off: ExtendScript first, UXP only when Photoshop is modal.

photoshopPath.title: Photoshop install path
photoshopPath.description: Optional. Leave empty to auto-detect Photoshop in /Applications or Program Files.
